title: Braised German Fennel with Crispy Fried Onions
description: A hearty German side dish featuring caramelized fennel and crispy fried onions.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
2. Add sliced fennel and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and tender, about 20 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, separate onion slices into individual rings.
4. In a separate pan, fry onion rings in batches until crispy and golden brown, about 2 minutes per batch.
5. Drain fried onions on paper towels.
6. To assemble the dish, place braised fennel on a serving platter or individual plates, topping with crispy fried onions.
7. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
